page: Google Cloud Platform e2-highmem-8 is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the E2 family. It features 8 vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores of an AMD EPYC 7B12 processor, utilizing simultaneous multithreading with 2 threads per core. The instance is configured with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware.

Benchmark evaluations show a strong single-core CPU performance rating in stress-ng, placing it in the top 25% of tested instances. However, multi-core CPU performance and Geekbench multi-core scores align with the average tier. Memory bandwidth tests indicate average performance, with read-only small block cached speeds at 507.84 GB/sec and uncached large block write speeds at 46.34 GB/sec. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression and Passmark extended instructions represent weaker performance areas, falling into the bottom 25%.

Given its high memory density relative to compute resources, the e2-highmem-8 offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-bound workloads that do not require high-performance local storage or GPU acceleration. It is well-suited for database operations, caching layers such as Redis, static web serving, and lightweight software compilation.
